description: This file defines an enum 'EntityAccountType' representing different types of account entities within the Apache Fineract project, with methods for conversion, comparison, and property checks.

classes.name: EntityAccountType
classes.description: An enumeration of various account types (CLIENT, LOAN, SAVINGS, etc.) with associated properties and utility methods.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the account type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the account type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Returns the EntityAccountType corresponding to the provided integer, or null if not found.

methods.name: getMinValue
methods.description: Returns the minimum integer value among all account types.

methods.name: getMaxValue
methods.description: Returns the maximum integer value among all account types.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the enum constant.

methods.name: isClientAccount
methods.description: Checks if the account type is CLIENT.

methods.name: isLoanAccount
methods.description: Checks if the account type is LOAN.

methods.name: isSavingsAccount
methods.description: Checks if the account type is SAVINGS.

methods.name: isCenterAccount
methods.description: Checks if the account type is CENTER.

methods.name: isGroupAccount
methods.description: Checks if the account type is GROUP.
